model_annotation: The chart, Figure 15, displays the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three categories: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive. The second pie chart, Approximate Number Generation, has three slices: Approximate Quantities (yellow, 45.03%), Comparative Relationships (pink, 36.26%), and Absolute Absence (blue, 18.71%), also with percentage labels inside. The third pie chart, Disjunctive & Conjunctive, comprises two slices: Conjunctive (pink, 50.49%) and Disjunctive (purple, 49.51%), again with percentage labels. None of the slices are visually emphasized, and the charts do not include a legend. The slices in each chart are not ordered in a particular size.
